entries.html: AGY_CLI_OSC7501 / AGY_CLI_OSC7501_MESSAGES (card-env) — two new unverified rows for OSC 7501 terminal status reporting (tab/window shows working/waiting/done/failed) and its brief message mode, named only in this release
Alt+M (card-keys) — new unverified row for sending using the opposite of your Queued Messages setting, named only in this release
agy plugin <cmd> (card-cli) — noted validate rewritten to check a plugin with the CLI's own loading rules, listing errors/warnings by file and line, plus the new --strict and --json flags

/diff (card-slash-tools) — noted the Commit Tree view counting commits instead of lines, restricting the cursor to commit rows with Enter opening them, filling the terminal height, and showing the latest 100 commits (previously 10) with scrolling
mcp_config.json (card-hooks) — noted the fix for plugin MCP servers using a header variable, such as a bearer token, sending the literal placeholder instead of the configured value

/tasks (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for the agent losing track of file changes, tasks, and session cost when a background command finished while it kept working, and for a background command's final output sometimes missing from its task log
agy (card-cli) — noted the fix for every message failing with Eligibility check failed after a brief service outage or rate limit at launch, requiring a restart

AGY_ADC_AUTH (card-env) — new unverified row for Application Default Credentials sign-in, named in this release (Claude Opus 5.5/Sonnet 5.5 availability) and in 1.3.3; absent from any docs page in sources.json
--mode <mode> (card-cli) — noted Auto mode's sandbox-escape review getting faster, allowing the workspace's own format/lint/fix commands, and blocking sensitive-data uploads
/diff (card-slash-tools) — noted the Commit Tree view's colorization (hashes, change IDs, dimmed descriptions, highlighted working-copy row, bold @)
/model (card-slash-core) — noted Claude Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 becoming available via ADC sign-in, gated by Google Cloud project access
/agents (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for lost subagent/workflow-agent questions, now surfaced as an <agent> has a question alert with a Ctrl+K/a picker, skipped in headless -p runs
.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md (card-skills) — noted the fix for skills/rules/workflows/Markdown agents failing to load when an unquoted description: contains a colon
/artifact (card-slash-tools) — noted the Mermaid frontmatter/%%{init}%%/v11-syntax rendering fix, and the / search highlight/crash fix for lowercase-length-changing characters such as İ
agy plugin <cmd> (card-cli) — noted the fix for a case-sensitive Plugin.json manifest not being found by install/validate/enable/disable
/plugin / /plugins (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for /plugin subcommands such as /plugin List failing on non-lowercase input

Re-extracted the slash command inventory from cli/reference and added five newly-documented commands
  • /browser <task>, /goal <objective>, and /learn [instruction] (card-slash-tools, Tools & tasks/Reasoning), and /schedule <when> <task> and /changelog (card-slash-tools) are confirmed on the current core slash command table. /browser, /goal, /learn, and /schedule were explicitly removed as phantom commands from the first draft (v1.2.2) for not existing on that table at the time; they're real now.

auto value on --mode <mode> (card-cli) — unverified Auto mode: autonomous approval of file edits and safe commands with sandbox-escape review by a separate agent; Linux/macOS only; absent from any agy --help this card was verified against
Shift+Tab (card-keys) — new unverified row for cycling agent execution modes, absent from the cli/reference keybinding tables
/config (card-slash-core) — noted the new Agent Mode entry for picking accept-edits/plan/auto
/diff (card-slash-tools) — noted syntax highlighting, code folding (Ctrl+O, f), and row virtualization for very large files
colorScheme (card-settings) — noted the fix for colors dropping to 256 in iTerm2 over SSH where COLORTERM isn't forwarded
agy plugin list (card-hooks) — noted the new --json flag and the fix for listing only imported plugins instead of every installed plugin
/model (card-slash-core) — noted the picker hiding third-party models a Business/GCP project can't access, instead of failing on send
agy remote-control (card-cli) — noted the browser Settings modal now mirroring real CLI settings, and serve sessions reading/saving settings.json
--agent <name> (card-cli) — noted the fix for an unknown agent name silently running the default agent instead of erroring or warning
-p (card-cli) — noted --print combined with --prompt-interactive now exiting with status 2 instead of 0
/resume (card-slash-core) — noted the @conversation: suggestion fallback after a 2-second stall
/mcp (card-slash-tools) — noted OAuth sign-outs now happening only on an actual rejection, not a transient network/timeout/server error
/permissions (card-slash-core) — noted the fix for Remote Control "Always allow" rules outliving their removal in the browser or this panel
/artifact (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for a truncated or header-only WebM file being rejected on read instead of breaking every later request
/plugin / /plugins (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for plugin details leaving out subagents a plugin declares in its root agents.json
_meta: {"antigravity/alwaysLoad": true} (card-hooks) — new unverified row: an MCP server can mark a tool as always loaded in its tools/list response; absent from docs/mcp
altScreenMode (card-settings) — noted the pinned prompt header while scrolling back through a long conversation in no-flicker mode
plugins/<name>/plugin.json (card-hooks) — noted a root-level agents.json for a plugin's own subagents, per the release notes only
enableTerminalSandbox (card-settings) — noted the macOS sandbox blocking ~/Library/Application Support reads by default, and the Windows PowerShell 7 (Microsoft Store) fallback fix
/usage (card-slash-tools) — noted individual quota being reported immediately instead of retried first
/plugin / /plugins (card-slash-tools) — noted the Installed tab's improved search (spaces, Enter, Space to toggle)
/add-dir (card-slash-tools) — noted the clearer directory not found/not a directory errors
/btw (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix stopping side questions from running user/workspace hooks
/agents (card-slash-tools) — noted the multi-repo subagent workspace isolation fix and the fix clearing a stopped subagent's pending approval right away
--remote-control (card-cli) and /remote-control (card-slash-tools) — noted both being disabled under ADC sign-in, which isn't supported yet, instead of failing unclearly
/keybindings (card-slash-core) — noted the macOS Option-key alt keybinding fix and the clear error when the configured editor can't be found
agy plugin <cmd> (card-cli) — noted the skills.json-exclusion and import-race fixes for validate and plugin listings
/diff (card-slash-tools) — noted the color.ui = always fix and the real-cause fix when the fallback git diff also fails

/plugin / /plugins (card-slash-tools) — noted this manager opening onto the official plugin marketplace, with agy plugin install <name>@antigravity-plugins-official and local-directory installs, plus install reliability improvements
plugins/<name>/plugin.json (card-hooks) — noted the .antigravity-plugin//.gemini-plugin/ manifest folder, skills field, PLUGIN_DATA, and bin/ folder, per the release notes only
--dangerously-skip-permissions (card-cli) — noted this no longer auto-approving the implementation plan in planning mode; it only skips tool permission prompts now
/artifact (card-slash-tools) — noted images now scaled to at most 2576px per side (previously 4096) to stay within Claude models' limits
/diff (card-slash-tools) — noted the Commit Tree Tab/arrow-key fix and the new Shift+Tab previous-view shortcut
/resume (card-slash-core) — noted the Other-tab import crash fix and the CJK conversation-title truncation fix

/diff (card-slash-tools) — noted the improved cross-file navigation (←/→ jump to the next file's first change, per-file cursor/scroll memory, n/N continuing across files) and the new change A/B · file X/Y header position indicator
/rewind (card-slash-core) — noted the fix for very long conversations listing space-compacted messages as (empty message) and erroring when selected

/plugin / /plugins (card-slash-tools) — noted the Windows MCP-server lifecycle fix for install/reinstall/uninstall, UTF-8 BOM support for plugin and MCP/hook config files, and the marketplace-install overwrite fix
/agents (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for relative skills:/plugins:/rules:/agents:/hooks: paths in Markdown custom agents, and subagents stuck on an error now showing Error: instead of Done
/tasks (card-slash-tools) — noted that timers, recurring jobs, and other background tools now appear here too, not just background shell commands
queuedMessages (card-settings) — noted the fix for "send-immediately" messages being silently queued whenever the agent had written or updated an artifact during the turn
notifications (card-settings) — noted that it now alerts for pending questions, not just tool permission prompts
/mcp (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for a server restart sometimes leaving it stopped with a "Failed to stop existing instances for reload" error
GEMINI_API_KEY (card-env) — noted that a dropped connection to the Gemini API now retries instead of failing the turn as cancelled
verbosity (card-settings) — noted the default changing from high to medium, per the release notes only; cli/reference still documents the old default and values
/diff (card-slash-tools) — noted j/k now moving the line cursor like the arrow keys instead of jumping between files
Esc (card-keys) — noted the new dismissible announcement cards for model launches and service notices, dismissed permanently with Esc on an empty prompt
enableTerminalSandbox (card-settings) — noted the Windows sandbox no longer needing administrator rights, with Python/Git/npm working out of the box
/artifact (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for .tiff images being misreported and silently converted to PNG
/config (card-slash-core) — noted the ←/→ shortcut to cycle a highlighted setting's value without opening the dropdown
/agents (card-slash-tools) — noted image-generation requests now running as a built-in image-generator subagent
altScreenMode (card-settings) — noted improved resize performance in no-flicker (altscreen) mode for long conversations
/artifact (card-slash-tools) — noted improved mouse text selection with auto-scroll and streaming-safe selection, in both the altscreen view and this viewer
queuedMessages (card-settings) — noted the fix so "send-immediately" messages sent while others are queued go out together, in order, instead of joining the queue
/tasks (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for the agent stalling after a background command crashed or was killed, and for headless -p runs exiting too early
editorMode (card-settings) — noted the fix for k in Vim Normal mode recalling command history instead of queued messages
.agents/rules/*.md (card-skills) — noted the fix for manifests in a parent .agents/ directory being ignored when a session started in a subdirectory
/skills (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for the / menu listing skills the current agent does not enable
/usage (card-slash-tools) — noted -p "/usage" printing quota reset times in the local time zone for interactive runs; piped and --json output stay UTC
useG1Credits (card-settings) — noted the immediate "credits too low" error once both the plan quota and AI credits are exhausted, instead of a multi-minute retry

CLI_GRAPHICS=kitty (card-env) — noted the SSH image-probe rework limiting image-capable terminals to Kitty/Ghostty over SSH, fixing garbled placeholders in WezTerm/Konsole and leftover escape codes in macOS Terminal.app
editorMode (card-settings) — noted the Vim mode cursor fix for emoji and combining characters
/resume (card-slash-core) — noted the fix for the search box wrapping long queries out of view
~/.gemini/GEMINI.md (card-skills) — noted the fix for the agent being blocked from reading global rules/customization files, and for symlinked global rule files being added to context twice
/mcp (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for MCP OAuth client registration responses using HTTP 200 instead of 201
/artifact (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for large WebP images not being scaled down like PNG/JPEG
queuedMessages (card-settings) — new setting for follow-up messages during a turn (queue default, or send-immediately); unverified, absent from the cli/reference settings table
--json-schema <schema> (card-cli) — noted that it now rejects plain text, bare type names, and missing schema files up front with exit code 1, instead of silently treating them as a string schema
agy remote-control (card-cli) — noted remote-control start running the daemon as a background process on systemd-free Linux machines instead of failing
/resume (card-slash-core) — noted faster loading for conversations with thousands of steps
/resume (card-slash-core) — noted the fix for resuming a conversation with a missing history step overwriting its most recent steps
/artifact (card-slash-tools) — noted the m hint now naming the content and mode it switches to, instead of a generic "toggle" label

GEMINI_API_KEY (card-env) — noted that a session using this key now stops immediately on an exhausted daily quota, spend cap, or depleted prepaid credits instead of retrying for several minutes; per-minute rate limits still retry
/artifact (card-slash-tools) — noted that bursts of scroll events are now coalesced before redrawing the full-screen view, cutting CPU use and scroll lag

CLI_GRAPHICS=kitty (card-env) — promoted to verified; the release notes reconfirm it and fix the CLI sending its image-support probe through screen/tmux/Zellij, which had corrupted the terminal or tab title
editorMode (card-settings) — noted the Vim mode fix for multibyte character navigation after r/f/F/t/T, fv/fV wrongly leaving Visual mode, and spurious empty undo steps from no-op edits
verbosity (card-settings) — noted the fix for resuming a long conversation at medium/low verbosity lagging for many seconds while history replayed
/effort (card-slash-core) — reasoning effort level gauge alongside --effort; unverified, absent from the cli/reference core slash command table
/plugin / /plugins (card-slash-tools) — interactive Plugins Manager and inline install/enable/disable/list, confirmed on cli/reference; noted the change to unconfigured-plugin loading behavior

/artifact (card-slash-tools) — noted the restored ASCII fallback for Mermaid/LaTeX in WezTerm and the VS Code integrated terminal, and the Copy on Select fix so the terminal's own selection, copy, and Ctrl+C work again

/agents (card-slash-tools) and --agent <name> (card-cli) — noted the fix for project custom agents in .agents/agents/ not being found across Desktop-App/trusted workspaces, --agent runs, and headless runs
verbosity (card-settings) — noted a medium level between high and low, per the release notes only; not yet on cli/reference
/artifact (card-slash-tools) — noted background diagram pre-rendering, the zoom flicker fix, and the combined footer hints
Esc (card-keys) — noted that it now closes an open suggestions dropdown before a second press interrupts the agent
enableTerminalSandbox (card-settings) — noted the agent asking to bypass the sandbox less often
-p (card-cli) — noted the fix so a run that streams part of a response then errors exits with code 3 and an AGY_ERROR line instead of exit code 0
agy remote-control (card-cli) — noted the fix for the old Remote Control installer crash-looping after an upgrade
/agents (card-slash-tools) — noted the @<subagent> <message> syntax to message a subagent directly, with autocomplete
/artifact (card-slash-tools) — noted the footer pan hint added for wide diagrams in the Kitty graphics viewer
/rewind (card-slash-core) — noted relative step timestamps and auto-focus on the most recent step
editorMode (card-settings) — noted Vim numeric count multipliers across Normal and Visual modes
-p (card-cli) — noted the fix for daemon background processes lingering past run exit and hanging output-reading scripts
--print-timeout <dur> (card-cli) — noted the fix so background tasks wait for the timeout deadline, capped at 30 minutes, instead of canceling ~5s after the agent went idle
Ctrl+G (card-keys) — noted the fix for hanging with a Vim: Warning: Output is not to a terminal error; external editors now run against a real terminal stdout
/voice (card-slash-tools) — noted dictation now auto-stops at 3 minutes 30 seconds instead of failing past 4 minutes
/artifact (card-slash-tools) — noted inline Kitty Graphics rendering for LaTeX math and Mermaid diagrams, with ASCII fallback and Left/Right panning
.agents/rules/*.md (card-skills) — noted the dedicated 20,000-token rule budget that keeps large rule sets from evicting skills, workflows, subagents, or MCP tools
/remote-control [on/off] (card-slash-tools) — session-scoped Remote Control for following and controlling the terminal session from another device; confirmed on cli/reference
--remote-control (card-cli) — startup flag that opens the same connection; marked unverified until a newer agy --help confirms it

Alt+F / Alt+B and Ctrl+W / Alt+Backspace / Alt+D (card-keys) — word-wise movement and deletion, which the release notes changed to stop at punctuation; unverified because the reference keybinding table omits them
--print-timeout <dur> (card-cli) — headless runs no longer default to a 5-minute limit; the summary drops the stale default and a note records it
-p (card-cli) — noted the structured AGY_ERROR: {...} stderr line and exit code 3 on agent or model API failures
/model (card-slash-core) — noted that a model switch submitted mid-turn waits for the queued prompt instead of changing the running turn
GEMINI_API_KEY (card-env) — noted that headless sessions authenticated this way keep daemon background commands running after the turn

/rewind (card-slash-core) — the note claimed rewind never touched files; the release notes describe workspace snapshot reverts, so it now says rewind restores the matching snapshot and records the 1.2.6 lookup fix
/tasks (card-slash-tools) — noted that an explicitly named background task keeps its name in notifications and the task list
/skills (card-slash-tools) — noted the /skills reload subcommand for live skill and slash-command rediscovery
/model (card-slash-core) — noted the inline argument autocomplete and the fuzzy search bar inside the picker
hooks.json (card-hooks) — noted the fix for configurations silently dropped under customization token-budget truncation
/copy (card-slash-tools) — noted the /copy btw subcommand that copies the active side-question response, plus argument ghost hints
/hooks (card-slash-tools) — noted that the listing includes hooks bundled inside enabled plugins

Removed 12 phantom slash commands absent from the vendor reference
  • /init, /compact, /plan, /status, /history, /mode, /effort, /reset, /goal, /learn, /browser, /schedule, /grill-me — a review of the prior draft found these did not exist on cli/reference.
